name: empty-state
title: Empty state
description: Say that there is nothing here yet and offer the next step.
a11y: Plain heading and text; put the action in children as a button or link.

props.name: title
props.description: Short headline saying what is missing, for example "No projects yet".

props.name: description
props.description: Optional sentence explaining why it is empty or what to do next.

props.name: children
props.description: The next step: a Button or link.

usage:
import {Button, EmptyState} from '@monoline/react';

<EmptyState title="No projects yet" description="Projects you create show up here."><Button variant="solid">New project</Button></EmptyState>
